SELECT
  strftime("Ngày", '%Y%m%d') || '-' || CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "Ngày", "Xe", "Làm gì", "Thợ") AS VARCHAR) AS order_id,
  CAST("Ngày" AS DATE) AS order_date,
  "Ngày" AS order_ts,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS product_code,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS product_group,
  "Làm gì" AS product_name,
  NULL::BIGINT AS qty,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS unit,
  "Tiền" AS amount,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS customer_name,
  "Thợ" AS staff,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS channel,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS payment,
  "_huy" AS is_cancelled,
  "_tra" AS is_returned,
  'service' AS line_kind
FROM "sosuaxe_all"
